name: Casa de Campo Resort & Villas
positioning: A 7,000-acre resort on the Dominican Republic's quiet southern coast, with three Pete Dye-designed golf courses, private villas and the Altos de Chavón village
best_for: Golfers who want to play Teeth of the Dog and two more Pete Dye-designed courses
Families who want supervised kids' and teen programs
Groups who want a private villa with dedicated staff

facts.text: The resort sits on the Dominican Republic's quiet southern coast.
The resort has three Pete Dye-designed golf courses, including Teeth of the Dog.
Teeth of the Dog has seven holes along the Caribbean Sea.
Teeth of the Dog was renovated and reopened on December 7, 2025.
The Dye Fore course overlooks Altos de Chavón, with seven holes perched 300 feet above the Chavón River.
Accommodation includes private villas with dedicated staff, Premier Suites and casitas.
The resort has an on-site marina where guests can charter fishing excursions.
The Equestrian & Polo Center offers trail rides and jumping lessons.
The spa offers specific Golfer's and Tennis Pro's Massages.
Villa Minuty is a gazebo wine bar and lounge serving wines by the glass or bottle.
Guests can take a catamaran to Catalina Island to snorkel.
Wi-Fi is free throughout the resort, including by the beach.

highlights.text: Altos de Chavón is a Mediterranean-style village overlooking the Chavón River.
Oscar de la Renta did the original interior design.
Chefs will cook dinner in a guest's private villa; the service must be requested 24 hours in advance.
Bonche 4 Teens is a supervised zone for teen guests with billiards, air hockey, music and movies.
The spa offers a range of Ayurvedic massages and body treatments.

considerations.text: The resort covers 7,000 acres; all stays include a golf cart for getting around.
Condé Nast Traveler notes food and beverage at the resort can be on the pricier side; an All-Inclusive Experience can be added to a reservation.
Swimwear is not permitted in the restaurants, and drone usage is not allowed anywhere on the property.
